plaatsen.tekst: In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.
Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.
And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.
And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
